## Activity

River Outreach recorded 66 captures during March 2026. This provides the activity count for the reporting period and confirms that image capture was undertaken at the site throughout the month. The recorded volume should be reviewed alongside the image-quality and grading results below when considering routine service performance.

## Image quality

Of the captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.0 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, so the result should remain visible in local quality monitoring and operational follow-up. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support consistent recording of equipment concerns and help identify whether the same issue is affecting image capture repeatedly.

## Grading

Grading identified 12 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 day. The grading result and turnaround measure should be considered together with the capture volume and ungradable findings. Continued attention to image quality, prompt escalation of recurring camera issues, and routine review of grading turnaround will support ongoing site operations at River Outreach.
